question_text: Discuss one ethical challenge when an ML content-recommendation service replicates users’ creative work across independently managed servers for its training dataset.
adaptation_rationale: Rebuilt scenario and response wording while retaining the supported reasoning; source-specific obsolete material excluded.
solution: Replication makes training data available across several servers, but copies may spread beyond the creator’s intended purpose or consent. Attribution or deletion requests may not propagate uniformly. Operators need clear consent, attribution and removal practices; decentralization alone does not resolve creators’ rights.
